scenes.label: door
scenes.say: Room nine stays closed after sunset.

scenes.label: bed
scenes.say: I am a bank clerk. Every night at two thirteen, I hear a pen scratching beneath my floor.

scenes.label: ledger
scenes.say: In the morning, the ledger has a fresh entry. In my own handwriting.

scenes.label: empty bed
scenes.say: Twenty years ago, the last clerk vanished.

scenes.label: phone
scenes.say: So I set up a camera. What it recorded...
